ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

Mode.description: What the report analyzes each run: `since_last_sent` (default, everything since the previous scheduled delivery), `last_n_days` (a trailing window of StartDaysAgo days) or `days_ago_range` (from StartDaysAgo to EndDaysAgo days ago).

StartDaysAgo.description: Lower bound of the analysis window, in days before the run. Required for `last_n_days` and `days_ago_range`. 1-365.

EndDaysAgo.description: Upper bound of the analysis window, in days before the run (0 = now). Required for `days_ago_range` and must be less than StartDaysAgo. 0-365.

Window.description: Analysis window for the report. Omitted means `since_last_sent`.

DashboardId.description: ID of a dashboard that grounds the AI report. Set exactly one of DashboardId and InsightId.

InsightId.description: Numeric ID of an insight that grounds the AI report. Set exactly one of DashboardId and InsightId.

PostAllInsightsInMainMessage.description: Slack subscriptions only. Insight and dashboard subscriptions: upload all insight images in the main Slack message instead of threading the rest. AI report subscriptions: post the chart images in the main message with the summary. Defaults to false.

IncludeImages.description: AI report subscriptions only: include generated chart images. Defaults to true.

IncludeFeedback.description: AI report subscriptions only: include report feedback links. Defaults to true.

IncludeManageLink.description: AI report subscriptions only: include a link to manage the subscription. Defaults to true.

IncludePosthogHint.description: AI report subscriptions only: include PostHog product guidance (rendered in Slack only). Defaults to true.
